Educational attainment of adults 25 and over, 2008 to 2025

American Community Survey 1-year estimates for the nation, regions, divisions, states, Puerto Rico, and the counties, metro and micro areas and places with 65,000 or more people. For years before 2025, the three lowest answers are added together to match the 2025 question.

    Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, table B15003. B15002 fills years where B15003 was published with no values.
